odd-even-arrays-skill-01.target: I can tell whether a group of up to 20 objects is odd or even by making pairs or counting by 2s.
odd-even-arrays-skill-01.ifCorrect: You can do this: can tell whether a group of up to 20 objects is odd or even by making pairs or counting by 2s.
odd-even-arrays-skill-01.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Looking at the tens digit instead of the ones digit, or thinking an odd number of objects can be put in pairs. Try this: Pair the objects; if one is left over, the number is odd. Then connect to the ones digit 0, 2, 4, 6, 8.

odd-even-arrays-skill-02.target: I can write an even number as the sum of two equal addends, such as 14 = 7 + 7.
odd-even-arrays-skill-02.ifCorrect: You can do this: can write an even number as the sum of two equal addends, such as 14 = 7 + 7.
odd-even-arrays-skill-02.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Writing two addends that are not equal (14 = 10 + 4), or trying to write an odd number as a double. Try this: Split the objects into two equal rows and check that every object has a partner.

odd-even-arrays-skill-03.target: I can find the total in an array with up to 5 rows and 5 columns and write an addition equation with equal addends.
odd-even-arrays-skill-03.ifCorrect: You can do this: can find the total in an array with up to 5 rows and 5 columns and write an addition equation with equal addends.
odd-even-arrays-skill-03.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Adding the number of rows and the number of columns (3 rows of 4 → 7). Try this: Circle each row, say how many are in it, and add the same number once for every row.

odd-even-arrays-skill-04.target: I can solve word problems about objects in rows and columns by drawing an array and writing an equation.
odd-even-arrays-skill-04.ifCorrect: You can do this: can solve word problems about objects in rows and columns by drawing an array and writing an equation.
odd-even-arrays-skill-04.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Adding the two numbers in the story instead of adding the row number again and again. Try this: Draw the rows with dots, then write the row amount once for each row before adding.
